notes: 7.0: macOS support (Apple Silicon, macOS 13+) — open LinguaHaru.app; real-time voice there runs Qwen3-ASR 1.7B on the chip's GPU and can translate what the Mac is playing. Much better real-time translation: captions no longer translate the previous sentences instead of the current one, sentences finished in the same second no longer overwrite each other, no mid-word cuts or one-character fragments, faster model start, and captions survive minimizing the window. Floating captions: no size limit, colors / font / background opacity. Optional recording per session, with playback and an on-demand summary in History; earlier real-time sessions that never showed up in History are restored. / 7.0：支持 macOS（Apple Silicon、macOS 13 以上）——打开 LinguaHaru.app 即可；Mac 上的实时语音使用 Qwen3-ASR 1.7B，在芯片自带 GPU 上运行，并能翻译电脑正在播放的声音。实时翻译大幅改进：不再出现译文翻成前几句的情况，同一秒内说的两句不再互相覆盖，不再在词中间切断或出现单字碎句，模型启动更快，最小化窗口时悬浮字幕不再消失。悬浮字幕：去掉尺寸限制，可设置颜色、字体和背景透明度。可选保存每次的录音，在历史记录中播放并按需生成总结；之前在历史记录里看不到的实时语音记录也已恢复。
